locality_scope: Same anchors sampled from top25% displacement magnitude per frame, nearest nonself versus random nonself partner. Fitted model motion, not independent motion ground truth.
coding_scope: Each no-sharing packet uses its original previous reference; regional symbols zero, minimal valid gates, total point symbols on identical grid. Original births/deletions/pose tail preserved, same production auto compressor. Complete motion packet bytes include structure and newborn poses. Not a retraining ablation or a new sequential stream. Float32 addition reorder differences separately audited.
region_overlay_scope: Actual final encoded owner IDs; stable per-node colours. Dashed outlines are convex envelopes of depth-filtered projected member centres within the crop, not image segmentation boundaries. Three most populous visible regions labelled per crop. Arrows use one actual member per labelled region, project its shared 3-D translation at the previous position, then multiply screen displacement by 8.
scene_projection_scope:
Make scene-based, read-only diagnostics from a certified fitted GS stream.

These figures analyse a frozen fitted motion field. The point overlays are
depth-filtered projections of Gaussian centres, not pixel optical flow or an
occlusion-exact GS render. No model is trained or changed by this script.
